modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: These carry-on allowances apply on all Nauru Airlines international travel.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Maximum dimensions 48(l) x 34(h) x 23(d) cm in both cabins; non-rigid bags such as garment bags up to 60(l) x 114(h) x 11(d) cm.

extra_items.value: At Nauru Airlines' absolute discretion, extras may include a handbag or purse, an overcoat, an umbrella or walking stick, a small camera or binoculars, reading matter, infant food and a small amount of duty-free goods.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: For international travel on Nauru Airlines, the checked allowance is set by fare type.

allowance_by_fare.value: Premium Business 45kg; Full flexible 45kg; Flexi Saver 30kg; Pacific Saver 23kg; Sale/other 23kg.

size_weight.value: No piece may exceed 32 kilograms or 158cm (length + width + height); total dimensions must not exceed 270cm, beyond which it must go as freight.

pooling.value: Baggage pooling is only allowed for a family group booked on the same booking reference (PNR).

prepaid_extra.value: Additional baggage of 5kg, 10kg, 15kg, 20kg or 25kg can be bought online up to twenty-four (24) hours before departure, space permitting.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: What Nauru Airlines does depends on whether the disruption was due to events beyond its control.

within_control.value: If a Nauru Airlines flight is cancelled, misses your destination or stopover, or makes you miss a confirmed connection on your ticket for reasons not beyond its control, it carries you on its next service with space, or re-routes you on other carriers or other transport, or, if neither is available or suitable, refunds you.

beyond_control.value: For changes due to events beyond its control, Nauru Airlines uses reasonable endeavours to rebook you on its next available flight at no extra cost; if it cannot rebook you acceptably, it gives a refund or flight credit where the purpose of your trip is void, subject to the fare rules. It does not cover your costs unless conventions, tariffs or laws require it.

counter_times.value: As a general rule, check-in opens three hours before departure and closes one hour before scheduled departure; your itinerary gives the deadline for each flight.

fare_name.value: Standard / Economy Light: includes 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item; checked bag allowance depends on route and fare category

seat_selection_included.value: Free seat assignment provided during online check-in; advance seat selection prior to check-in is available for a fee

change_cancellation_policy.value: Ticket modifications and cancellations are subject to carrier fare rules, change fees, and applicable fare difference

modules.title: Cabins and seating
modules.lede: Choose a seat by location and legroom, or accept a free seat assignment at check-in. Use your flight seat map because options vary with the aircraft.

seat_options.value: Standard seats, preferred location seats, and extra legroom seating options are available depending on aircraft and cabin class

reserved_or_random.value: Reserve a specific seat in advance for a fee or free depending on fare class, or receive a free seat assignment during online check-in

family_seating.value: Children traveling with an accompanying adult are seated together during advance seat reservation or at check-in
